stages.name: exact-source-and-version-floor-preflight
acceptance: Resolve exact Transformers source and PEFT 0.20.0 source/package identity before execution.
Read the pinned Transformers MIN_PEFT_VERSION from exact source rather than assuming moving-main behavior.
Reject or quarantine a successor plan requiring PEFT >=0.20.0 when that same planned environment pins 0.19.1.
Do not treat an incumbent older purpose-pinned stack as broken solely because a newer Transformers source raises its minimum.

stages.name: adapter-lifecycle-reference
acceptance: Use fixed synthetic or public non-secret LoRA fixtures.
Exercise adapter load, add, switch, delete, save and reload.
Record adapter state keys, shapes, dtypes and content digests before and after round trip.
Require deterministic output parity within a declared numeric tolerance.

stages.name: stable-current-versus-successor-matrix
acceptance: Run the same fixtures on the currently admitted Forge compatibility baseline and the exact successor pair.
Classify differences as expected API floor, regression, improvement, unsupported or unknown.
Package installation alone is not compatibility evidence.

stages.name: distributed-export-integrity-regression
acceptance: Reuse the Frontier #110 / Forge #257/#258 gathered and ungathered LoRA integrity cases.
Preserve malformed lora_A/lora_B shape detection, exact base/adapter binding and immutable byte readback.
Explicitly supplied state_dict provenance remains UNKNOWN unless independently proven complete.

stages.name: owner-lane-handoff
acceptance: Only after Forge correctness passes, hand the exact package set to szl-gpu-bridge for hardware/laptop qualification.
Only after owner-lane evidence passes may szl-holdings/a11oy consider a training-box pin update.
Preserve incumbent rollback until all owner-specific controls pass.

stages.name: failure-rollback-and-proof-boundary
acceptance: Exercise incompatible-version, malformed-adapter, load failure, save failure and cancellation paths.
No Hugging Face artifact/runtime projection follows from partial evidence.
a-11-oy.com remains unchanged and a11oy.net may publish only exact-source measured receipts with known bounds.

claimBoundary: This plan prepares deterministic compatibility evaluation only. It does not authorize dependency promotion, training, model or adapter publication, runtime route changes, provider writes, or production claims.
